sub_graphs.title: EIP-7756: EVM Trace Generation Lifecycle
sub_graphs.description: Models the lifecycle of trace output generation during EVM operation execution

nodes.label: EVM Operation Pending Execution
nodes.description: An EVM opcode is about to be executed, trace output not yet generated

nodes.label: Execute EVM Opcode
nodes.description: The EVM executes a single opcode instruction and captures state

nodes.label: Operation Trace Captured
nodes.description: The trace data for a single operation has been captured including pc, op, gas, stack

nodes.label: Emit Trace JSON Line
nodes.description: Output a single JSON object containing the trace for the executed operation

nodes.label: Trace Line Emitted
nodes.description: One JSON object per operation has been written to trace output

nodes.label: Transaction Execution Complete
nodes.description: All operations have been executed and traced, summary line pending

nodes.label: Emit Summary Line
nodes.description: Output the final summary JSON object with pass/fail status and output data

edges.label: Capture pc, op, gas, stack, depth
Continue to next operation if not complete

external_entities.name: Trace Consumer
external_entities.description: External tool or debugger consuming the JSON trace output

sub_graphs.title: EIP-7756: Trace Field Validation Rules
sub_graphs.description: Models the validation constraints for trace output fields and formats

nodes.label: Raw Trace Data Available
nodes.description: Trace data has been captured but not yet validated for output

nodes.label: Validate Mandatory Fields Present
nodes.description: Verify pc, op, opName, gas, stack, depth fields are present

nodes.label: Mandatory Fields Valid
nodes.description: All required trace fields are present and correctly typed

nodes.label: Validate EOF-Specific Fields
nodes.description: Check section and functionDepth fields for EOF containers

nodes.label: EOF Fields Validated
nodes.description: EOF-specific fields are correctly present or absent based on context

nodes.label: Validate Error Field Handling
nodes.description: Ensure error field is only present on exceptional halts

nodes.label: Trace Output Valid
nodes.description: All validation rules have passed for trace output

nodes.label: Trace Output Invalid
nodes.description: Validation failed, trace does not conform to specification

sub_graphs.title: EIP-7756: Exceptional Halt Trace Handling
sub_graphs.description: Models how trace output handles exceptional halts and error conditions

nodes.label: Operation Executing
nodes.description: EVM operation is currently being executed

nodes.label: Exceptional Halt Occurred
nodes.description: Operation triggered an exceptional halt condition

nodes.label: Capture Error Information
nodes.description: Record error description and revert reason if supported

nodes.label: Error Information Captured
nodes.description: Error field populated with description, trace ready for output

nodes.label: Suppress STOP Trace
nodes.description: Do not emit trace line for STOP operation when error occurred

nodes.label: Normal Operation Completion
nodes.description: Operation completed without exceptional halt

nodes.label: Contract Out of Instructions
nodes.description: Contract ran out of instructions without explicit STOP

edges.label: Prevent STOP trace when instructions exhausted

ambiguities.text: Clients may output Number or Hex-Number interchangeably; consumers should accept either
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume trace consumers must implement type coercion for numeric fields, treating both formats as semantically equivalent. Validation should accept either format.

ambiguities.text: SHOULD contain revert reason if supported
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume error field may or may not contain revert reason depending on client implementation. Security analysis should not rely on revert reason presence.

ambiguities.text: CLI options controlling strict type enforcement are mentioned but not fully specified
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume CLI options are implementation-specific and may vary between clients. Trace output validation should be lenient on type strictness.

implicit_assumptions.description: Trace consumers trust that the trace output accurately reflects EVM execution state
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Malicious or buggy clients could emit false trace data, leading debuggers and security tools to incorrect conclusions about contract behavior

implicit_assumptions.description: Tracing endpoints have appropriate access restrictions in production environments
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Exposed tracing endpoints could leak sensitive execution data or be used for denial of service through resource-intensive trace generation

implicit_assumptions.description: Trace output is written atomically per operation to prevent interleaving
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Concurrent trace generation could produce malformed or interleaved JSON output, breaking trace consumers
